page.layout: One page: a digitiser's cover sheet, with the e-rara logo at top right, a title block centred in the upper half, and a rule-bounded block of multilingual usage notes and the Visual Library logo at the foot.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not printed text. It is omitted from the transcription: the e-rara logo, the title block, the usage notes (German, English, French, Italian) and the Visual Library logo are all digitiser material. The title block gives the work as "Ioh. Henrici Heideggeri Medulla theologiae Christianae", Heidegger, Johann Heinrich, Tiguri, 1696, Zentralbibliothek Zürich. This is the book's title, not a printed page of it.
